changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders.

study.title: RTB_TRICOT_MFANTSEMAN
study.description:
Scaling Roots Tubers and Bananas Crop Variety
Validation and Diffusion Using Farmer Citizen Science

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: International Potato Center (CIP)
data_producer.program: Scaling RTB crop variety validation and diffusion using farmer citizen science in Ghana and Rwanda (RTB Scaling Fund, 2020 to 2021); SweetGAINS
data_producer.partner: CSIR-Crops Research Institute (CSIR-CRI); CSIR-Savanna Agricultural Research Institute (CSIR-SARI)

funder.awardTitle: Scaling RTB crop variety validation and diffusion using farmer citizen science in Ghana and Rwanda (RTB Scaling Fund, 2020 to 2021)

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus package number
Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, interview point, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
Gender of the participant
First level administrative unit of the country (see metadata.admin_levels)
Second level administrative unit of the country
Name of the place below the lowest administrative level (village, community)
Planting date (YYYY-MM-DD)
What did you do with this field the previous season?
What equipment was used for land preparation?
What is the land quality of the test plot?
What type of soil at the sowing area?
Where the planting date comes from (reported by the farmer, or inferred window between planting_date_earliest and planting_date_latest)
Earliest planting date of a site without a reported one, the earliest date reported in the trial
Latest planting date of a site without a reported one, the median date reported in the trial plus 7 days (vines do not survive longer between delivery and planting)
Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot
Data collection moment (form) as named in the trial
Planned day of the collection moment, counted from the start of the trial as set in the trial design (the day of sowing in most designs); the same for every site. The actual date is moment_date
Day the form of the collection moment was filled in or submitted for the site (YYYY-MM-DD), the actual date of the observation; null when the source has none or the form was typed in after the season
Variable name, harmonised across trials
Identifier of the harmonised question
Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
Unit of numeric values. Yield values refer to the entire plot
Quality flag (implausible_yield_per_area, outlier_vs_trial_median, unit_unclear, derived)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Which shows the most damage from other diseases or pests?
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Which variety is most sensitive to drought?
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Which variety is fastest in covering the soil?
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Which variety shows severe virus symptoms?
